title: A demo whose public name does not reach tracy-web is not reported live: the install fails ADDRESS_SHADOWED
steps: S1: Run node --test apps/tracy-web/test/demo-address-shadowed.test.mjs (no Postgres needed): advanceDemo on a provision the host reports done, on this process's own host, with a network that answers the probe with 502.
S2: Same, with a network that echoes the x-tracy-address-probe token.
S3: Same file: GET /__tracy/address-probe with the probe header on a demo's label through barRoutes.
expect: S1: view.error is ADDRESS_SHADOWED, state failed, no update sets publish = 'published', the job is written failed at step address and failureReason reads the 'does not reach Tracy' message.
S2: the demo is marked live.
S3: 200, body equal to the token, cache-control no-store.
evidence: 15/10/2026: business-joomla.tracy.ai and business-emdash.tracy.ai answered Cloudflare 502 on every path (stale DNS + tunnel 91b557ed rules outranking *.tracy.ai) while the /ops reinstall of tracy-business/j6 reported the demo live
fence: advanceDemo requires tracy-web's echo of a fresh token on the demo's public name before markDemoLive
